integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically from the exact neighborhood-weight inequalities. Finite enumeration for 3<=n<=12 and total labeling weight at most 4 checks the proof boundary and the complete minimum-function classification but is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies minimum-weight Italian (Roman {2}) dominating functions of crown graphs only. The originality search found no covering crown-graph statement, but the publisher PDF of the 2016 foundational paper was not fully accessible in the inspected path, so an older poorly indexed equivalent formulation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Minimum Italian dominating functions of crown graphs
